responsibility: This definition module declares PIM- and Logitech-compatible terminal I/O routines for unsigned integer types in GNU Modula-2. It owns the public API and Done status flag for reading and writing CARDINAL, LONGCARD, and SHORTCARD values in decimal and hexadecimal form using the current InOut terminal stream conventions.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition module for the CardinalIO pair, publishing the Done variable and the unsigned terminal I/O procedure signatures; the companion CardinalIO.mod implements them through InOut and StringConvert.
